tasks.title: A skill invocation has a stable identity that approval resumes
tasks.evidence: Two real defects found by driving the HTTP path, not the unit seams. (1) every invocation created a new mission, so approving the parked run could never reach it -- run_skill now accepts a run_id and _existing_run continues it. (2) the parked confirmation id was never recorded on the step, and PermissionEngine.evaluate mints a fresh id per call, so a stored approval could never match -- the id is now written into the step's detail and matched against that. Live: invoke parks, approve with a lease, same mission resumes, completed/verified, file written, observation carries sha256.
